function: Channel estimation in the delay-Doppler domain for OTFS: a residual denoiser on the LS estimate plus a learned soft-shrinkage layer exploiting channel sparsity (p. 2, 4)
system: OTFS link, antenna count not stated, no RIS; M=24 subcarriers, N=20 slots, P=4 paths, 3 GHz carrier, 7.5 kHz subcarrier spacing (p. 5, 6)
method: Deep residual shrinkage network: convolutional denoising blocks on the LS estimate, then soft shrinkage with learned adaptive thresholds; supervised, MSE loss, Adam, learning rate 0.01 (p. 4-6)
data_channel: Simulated DD-domain channel with P=4 paths and complex Gaussian coefficients, AWGN or t-distribution noise; Monte-Carlo data, 27,000 training and 3,000 test samples (p. 5, 6)
test_conditions: Separate 3,000-sample test set; AWGN or t-distribution noise; for varying P and MN the dataset is regenerated and the model retrained (p. 6, 7)
baselines: Classical: LMMSE and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL); learned: DCNN, the DRSNN without the regularization layer (a variant of the proposed method) (p. 6)
metrics: NMSE, failure rate of support recovery, online estimation time, and complexity order (p. 6, 7)
complexity: Table II: LMMSE O(Ln^3), SBL O(k Ln^3), DCNN and DRSNN linear in Ln; DRSNN online estimation time 0.43 ms (p. 6, 7)
q1_support: p. 5: "The channel coefficients are generated by using a complex Gaussian distribution". Not met: the channel is a custom sparse DD model with P=4 paths; no standardized model or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 7: "we regenerated the dataset with varying P and M N and retrained the model accordingly". Not met: each new P or MN is retrained; the t-distribution noise test (p. 6) is not stated to use a model trained on AWGN.
q3_support: p. 6: "denoising convolution neural network (DCNN), i.e., the DRSNN without the regularization layer". Not met: LMMSE and SBL are classical baselines, but the only learned baseline is an ablation of the proposed network; no earlier learned estimator is compared.
q4_support: p. 7: "A comparison of the computational complexity is provided in TABLE II"; p. 6: "the online estimation time for the proposed method is only 0.43 milliseconds"
q5_support: p. 6: "respectively, both generated by the Monte-Carlo method". Not met: the data are self-generated by simulation; no code or data link or DOI is given.
notes: Included as area 4 (OTFS channel estimation in the DD domain). q3 is 0 because the paper defines its DCNN as the DRSNN without the regularization layer (p. 6), an ablation, although a CNN denoiser is a standard architecture; the reviewer may confirm. The t-distribution noise test (Fig. 3, p. 6) does not say the model was trained on another noise, so q2 is 0. Reference [9] (an earlier DL estimator by the same authors) is cited but not compared. The PDF prints no DOI, so the match with the DOI rests on the file name. p. 1 of the PDF is an IEEE copyright notice and the paper starts on p. 2; pages are file pages.
